verdict.rationale: Warp generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own terminal data inside the product. Documented features include 'Ask Warp AI' to explain errors and missing dependencies in command output, contextual suggestions inside psql/mysql and other CLIs, and an agent that runs commands, interprets results and pulls context from databases via MCP. Hands-on reports corroborate this: a user received proactive Active AI fix suggestions after an error, and another had Warp examine old files and suggest whether to delete them. Missing for 10: first-party docs on proactive insight features (Active AI/Prompt Suggestions), explicit insight or summarization over datasets such as query results.
